description: Performance improvement plan — Draft a fair performance improvement plan: neutral summary, expectations, 3-5 SMART goals with measures, targets and due dates, company support, outcome statement and a signable markdown document. Offline: plan end date and weekly or biweekly check-ins on business days (US federal holidays skipped) with a midpoint review, goal measurability check, subjective-wording flags (attitude, not a team player...), missing-examples and missing-support flags, and a legal-risk screen (protected activity such as complaints, FMLA, workers comp = HIGH; protected traits = MEDIUM). Params: role, issues (both required), days=30|60|90, start=YYYY-MM-DD, cadence=weekly|biweekly, name, manager. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
